:::{#def-generated-sigma-algebra}
#### $\sigma$-algebra generated by a collection

Let $\coll$ be a [collection](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-collection) of subsets of a set $S$.
The **$\sigma$-algebra generated by** $\coll$,
written $\gensalg{\coll}$,
is the intersection of all the $\sigma$-algebras on $S$ that contain every set in $\coll$.

:::
